workflow: Created human commander plus two fallback crew, enabled modern Training assist in lobby, readied and started, paused and toggled assist off/on, resumed and observed the measured server outcome.

observation.context: The flight has ended. These are frozen endpoint measurements, including the velocity at contact or termination. The engine is off and no further motion is propagated.
